title: Walkthrough project brief
description: Input file for project create --brief. Records the creator's existing authority; it does not grant access, effects, review or publication permission. Runtime validation additionally checks URL normalization, credentials, application-origin membership and loopback scope.

brief.description: What the film should let its audience understand about the product.

applicationUrl.description: An HTTP(S) application URL without credentials.

navigationOrigins.description: Exact normalized HTTP(S) origins including the application URL origin. No path, trailing slash or credentials. These constrain document navigation, not application API or subresource traffic.

network.description: loopback-only admits navigation hosts localhost, 127.0.0.1 and [::1].

allowedEffects.description: The author must judge actions against this mandate; it is not an automatic semantic filter.

inputRoots.description: Absolute local directories admitting intended input files; an empty array admits no external upload roots.
